Official @supabase/supabase-js 2.117.3 browser UMD distribution, copied unchanged from its npm package. License: MIT (see LICENSE).

To update, fetch an exact version with `npm pack @supabase/supabase-js@<version>` (npm verifies registry integrity), extract `package/dist/umd/supabase.js` and `package/LICENSE`, and rerun the browser session tests. No CDN or build step is required at runtime.
